question: What must an Express Entry arranged-employment job-offer letter contain?

claims.text: A letter from the employer offering the job in Canada is required if the applicant claims arranged employment, printed on company letterhead with contact details, supervisor signature, start date, continuous paid full-time commitment, title, duties, work hours, salary, and associated LMIA details.
claims.quote: A letter from the employer(s) offering the job in Canada is required

basis: The applicant submitted a written job offer letter in the written_job_offer_lmia upload slot for case e891fe38c1b6ace7fd5b685a8901f9a9 to support an arranged employment claim.
